impact: N-008 VAL-UI-010 (sha256 mismatch) and VAL-UI-011 (protocol version mismatch) require a blocking modal that makes the main UI unreachable. Actual behavior: both errors route through the generic supervisor "unavailable" path and emit a non-blocking "Engine unavailable" banner in Diagnostics.tsx — the main recording UI remains accessible. No `helper-binary-tampered` IPC code exists. No protocol-mismatch-specific modal. The underlying checks fire correctly (verifySha256 in engine-supervisor.ts:175, connectAndVerify:350) but the required blocking renderer behavior is absent. Prevents T-010d acceptance and T-010e gate.
title: VAL-UI-010/011: helper sha256 and protocol mismatch show non-blocking banner instead of blocking modal
